note: Licenses verified against official repos/docs; re-verified by weekly CI freshness checks. 'paid-reference' marks a paid service included for context — TZ-taste exists as its free alternative.

sources.grab: Install the design-taste-frontend skill; study its pre-flight checks, dial system, and anti-repetition rules.
sources.name: taste-skill
sources.what: The anti-slop agent skill that helped inspire TZ-taste's protocol. Tunable dials for layout variance, motion, and density.

sources.grab: Browse the live catalog for shader and 3D component patterns; copy its live-preview plus source-tab UX for your own docs.
sources.name: ThreeUI Community
sources.what: 50 free Three.js UI components with live interactive previews and complete source. The model for catalog-style documentation.

sources.grab: Copy individual components into your own projects (shadcn-style); do not repackage them as a competing library.
sources.name: React Bits
sources.what: 140+ animated React components free for use in your own products, incl. commercial. Note: the Commons Clause prohibits redistributing them as a competing library — we link, never repackage.

sources.grab: Use as the accessible component base, then skin it with any TZ-taste DNA's tokens.
sources.name: shadcn/ui
sources.what: Accessible React primitives you copy into your own codebase. The sane default underneath any visual language.

sources.grab: Map DNA tokens to CSS variables, then use utilities for layout speed without losing the system.
sources.name: Tailwind CSS
sources.what: Utility-first CSS framework. Pairs with DNA tokens via CSS variables for fast, systematic styling.

sources.grab: ScrollTrigger for scroll choreography; match easing and duration to your DNA's motion guidance.
sources.name: GSAP
sources.what: Industrial-strength web animation — free for all use incl. commercial (not open source; Webflow's no-charge license).

sources.grab: One-line smooth scroll that instantly makes pages feel expensive.
sources.name: Lenis
sources.what: Buttery smooth scrolling with a tiny footprint. Instant perceived quality.

sources.grab: One consistent stroke weight across the whole set — never mix icon styles.
sources.name: Lucide
sources.what: Beautiful, consistent open-source icons. The cure for emoji-as-icons.

sources.grab: Multiple weights (thin → fill) let icons match your DNA's voice, from delicate to brutal.
sources.name: Phosphor Icons
sources.what: 1,512 icons × 6 weights. More expressive range than most sets.

sources.grab: Clash Display, General Sans, and Satoshi cover most DNA display needs. Serve via Fontshare's CDN; don't redistribute the files.
sources.name: Fontshare
sources.what: High-quality free fonts for commercial use (not open source). A step up from overused defaults when you need it.

sources.grab: Every TZ-taste DNA type pairing loads from here — copy the pairing, not just the font.
sources.name: Google Fonts
sources.what: The open font library behind every DNA type pairing in this repo.

sources.grab: Use its style/font lookups when a brief needs a pairing outside the 12 TZ-taste DNAs.
sources.name: UI/UX Pro Max skill
sources.what: Agent skill with 240+ styles and 127 font pairings as a lookup database. Free Basic version is MIT (a separate paid Premium exists).

sources.grab: Study its AGENT-BOOTSTRAP flow and design-taste scoring rubric for review-mode work.
sources.name: agent-design-taste
sources.what: Agent-first taste system with style-DNA routing, context profiles, and a design-taste score.

sources.grab: Study what they charge for — then use TZ-taste's prompts/ for free. Reference, not endorsement.
sources.name: SceneAI
sources.what: Premium UI prompt library: 120+ prompts, $89/3 months or $249 lifetime. The paid service TZ-taste is the free alternative to.

sources.grab: Real photography for mockups — gray boxes are a slop tell. Try ?grayscale for instant art direction.
sources.name: Lorem Picsum
sources.what: Free placeholder photography (MIT-licensed service). For mockups that don't look mocked-up.
